title: deputyOS mounts policy
description: Schema for /etc/deputyos/mounts-policy.json — the single source of truth for which host folders, removable drives, and network shares the agent can see. Read + mutated by `deputyctl mounts`; materialised at boot by deputyos-mounts.service. Credentials NEVER live here — SMB/CIFS credentials are referenced by name and stored in /etc/deputyos/secrets.env. Schema version 1; bump on breaking changes and mirror in release::Manifest::mounts_policy_schema_version.

host_fs.description: Host-filesystem bind mounts (WSL2 /virtiofs / DrvFs / a bare-metal host folder). Every guest_path must live under /mnt/deputyos/ so AppArmor can confine it.

id.description: Stable, human-friendly id (e.g. documents, code). Unique across host_fs + network.

host_path.description: Path on the host (informational; the materialiser bind-mounts it).

guest_path.description: Path inside the appliance. MUST be under /mnt/deputyos/.

removable.description: Policy for removable drives (USB, SD). Handled by the udev rule + deputyos-mount-removable.sh, not the boot materialiser.

enabled.description: Whether the udev rule reacts to removable-media events at all.

auto_mount.description: If true, mount on insert; else wait for an explicit action.

mount_options_unknown_fs.description: Mount options forced for filesystems the appliance does not recognise. Defaults to nosuid,nodev,noexec. crypto_LUKS and empty FSTYPE are refused outright.

network.description: Network shares (SMB/CIFS, NFS). Credentials are NOT stored here — for CIFS, put <KEY>=username:password in /etc/deputyos/secrets.env and name the key via credentials_env.

id.description: Stable id (e.g. nas-photos). Unique across host_fs + network.

source.description: Server path. //nas.lan/photos for cifs, nas.lan:/srv/photos for nfs.

guest_path.description: Path inside the appliance. MUST be under /mnt/deputyos/.

credentials_env.description: Name of the env var in /etc/deputyos/secrets.env holding CIFS credentials. NFS usually omits this.
